### How You Can Be Restored from Brokenness - Powerpoint - March 9
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-march-5-2013.html
Passage: Jeremiah 30:17
Points:
- Just as an inventor knows how to fix the machine he built, our Creator knows how to repair our broken lives.
- Human efforts to resolve our deepest issues frequently leave us stalled and helpless.
- God notices when His people feel discarded, broken, or cast out as unvalued.
- Surrendering our brokenness into God's hands allows Him to renew and fully restore us.
